test_title: PYST 17: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 15 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: **Choose the sentence with no spelling error. **

options.text: He stuod outside the bathroom door.
He stood outcide the bathroom door.
He stood outside the bathroom door.
He stood outside the bathrum door.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 - "He stood outside the bathroom door."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**stood**" is in the past tense, which is correct.
 
• The word "**outside**" is spelt correctly.
 
• The word "**bathroom**" is spelt correctly.
 
• The word "**door**" is spelt correctly.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 has a spelling error - "**stuod**" should be "**stood**".
 
• Option 2 has a spelling error - "**outcide**" should be "**outside**".
 
• Option 4 has a spelling error - "**bathrum**" should be "**bathroom**".
